principle: Organization coordinates responsibilities; it does not grant capabilities or permissions.

teams.name: Engineering & Delivery
teams.purpose: Turn scoped work into tested, reviewable, traceable changes.

teams.name: Security & Governance Assurance
teams.purpose: Review security, compliance, incidents, and evidence without granting authority.

teams.name: Research & Strategy
teams.purpose: Convert research, market signals, cognition, and specialist analysis into evidence-backed decisions.

teams.name: Product & Experience
teams.purpose: Shape product direction and user experiences across creative, product, game, and spatial work.

teams.name: Operations & Support
teams.purpose: Coordinate operational support, revenue, finance, growth, and specialist services around governed delivery.

division_assignments.rationale: Cognition specialists primarily support evidence synthesis and analytical strategy.
Creative specialists shape product and experience outcomes.
Engineering owns implementation and technical delivery.
Finance supports governed operational and commercial decisions.
Game specialists contribute to product and interactive experience work.
Geospatial specialists contribute domain analysis and evidence.
Health specialists contribute evidence-focused domain analysis.
Market intelligence informs discovery and strategic decisions.
Growth execution is coordinated with operational and commercial delivery.
Product owns product direction and prioritization.
Delivery coordinates execution, traceability, and completion.
Research provides evidence and synthesis for decisions.
Revenue work belongs to governed commercial operations.
Security owns assurance and incident responsibilities.
Spatial computing is an experience and product specialty.
Specialists are routed according to the operational mission they support.
Support owns operational response and reporting.
Verification closes delivery loops with evidence and quality gates.

workflows.name: Governed Change Delivery
workflows.purpose: A repeatable implementation path with explicit review and evidence verification.

steps.purpose: Translate the request into bounded deliverables and success criteria.
Independently inspect correctness, maintainability, and regressions.
Verify evidence and confirm the change matches the stated scope.

workflows.name: Security Assurance
workflows.purpose: Inspect a proposed change for security and compliance risks before acceptance.

steps.purpose: Identify material trust-boundary and security risks.
Check applicable compliance controls and evidence.
Collect only the evidence required to support the assurance decision.

workflows.name: Evidence-Backed Discovery
workflows.purpose: Move from research signals to a traceable decision without turning research into authority.

steps.purpose: Analyze uncertainty, assumptions, and competing explanations.
Frame an evidence-backed strategic recommendation without claiming execution authority.
Confirm sources, unresolved uncertainty, and provenance before handoff.

workflows.name: Product Discovery to Delivery
workflows.purpose: Coordinate product discovery, experience design, implementation, and evidence-based acceptance.

steps.purpose: Identify user and market signals that justify the opportunity.
Convert evidence into bounded product outcomes.
Define experience structure and acceptance expectations.
Implement the approved scope without changing governance boundaries.
Verify delivered behavior against the evidence-backed acceptance criteria.
